dialogue.t: Are you out here on a stroll as well?
Ah, my young friend, have you brought any Bulle Fruit? Please, share it with me, and we can eat while we talk.
Statues are wordless poems, so one shouldn't appreciate them on an empty stomach. A duelist told me so, during the final duel of his life.
Thank you. Looking at your expression, you seem interested in that duelist? Well, it was a long time ago...
